description: Sidewalk to Street "Walkability" Ratio is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center. We’ve been asked to create measures of communities that are “walkable” for several projects. While there is no standard definition of what makes a community “walkable”, and the definition of “walkability” can differ from person to person, we thought an indicator that explores the total length of available sidewalks relative to the total length of ... Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center. Its tags are PMOMS, pedestrian, sidewalk, structural racism, walkability. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
